what: Week 3 request-cost distribution over the full pinned corpus (WEEK3_IMPLEMENTATION_README.md section 6 W3-5).

percentile_convention.note: Legacy first-session records used numpy_linear (numpy-linear-v1) and are deliberately NOT recomputed under this convention (WEEK2_PLAN.md 10.5).
